correctness.rationale: The complete 24-triangle, 30-edge graph has exactly 20 enumerated perfect matchings and 66,370 simplicial faces. A full 33,184-pair acyclic Morse matching leaves two 3-simplices and its entire oriented Hasse digraph passes an exact topological sort. Each of the 12 D6 actions is checked as a graph-edge permutation. Independent orientation-sign and orbit-parity sums agree at every element. Since reduced integral homology is rank two only in degree three, the Hopf trace gives the exact rational character and quotient invariant ranks.

value.rationale: For the canonical exceptional 2 by 2 by 2 honeycomb singled out by Bayer et al., the exact rational D6 module is not determined by the established wedge-of-two-spheres type. Its two distinct reflection-axis quotient Betti ranks, distinct rotation behavior and complete 12-class character are motivated natural symmetry invariants, not an arbitrary slice or numerology.
